nina_ml: Quick note — ran v3a-int4 as 1% canary + 1% shadow. Global composite looks neutral but a specific "long-instruction" slice (>=2500 tokens) shows a consistent small drop.

chris_reliability: Numbers? single snapshot noise or trending?

nina_ml: Snapshot: samples=750, rougeL_delta=-0.032, p=0.038, mrr_delta=-0.022. Last two snapshots: -0.02, -0.032 (so trending slightly). Latency fine.

eva_prod: Product cares a lot about long-instruction fidelity. Can we quantify customer impact? Any examples?

nina_ml: Uploaded top 12 diff pairs to the eval run. Mostly early-stop on appended instructions and missing final steps.

deploy-bot: deploybot: canary v3a-int4 started 4395001200, shadowing enabled.

chris_reliability: Suggest we require a slice-specific pass: long-instruction must have delta > -0.02 OR p >= 0.05 across 3 consecutive snapshots to allow promotion. Otherwise hold.

eva_prod: If we hold, customers waiting on the feature need an ETA. How much does this slow things?

nina_ml: If enforced, current candidate would wait one additional promotion window (~24h) while we run an expanded longdoc sample (2x size). If expanded run still fails we'll rollback.

chris_reliability: Also propose auto-rollback rule: if any critical slice delta <= -0.03 AND global composite delta <= -0.01 for 12h, trigger swap-to-baseline and open incident.

eval-bot: eval 4395001234: long-instruction: samples=750, rougeL_delta=-0.032, p=0.038; global_composite_delta=-0.006. Link: https://ci.internal/evals/4395001234

eva_prod: OK hold for now. Please add audit entry and post examples in the PR so PMs can triage.

nina_ml: Will do. I'll start the expanded run now and tag results here. Thanks all.
